_comment: Offline fallback pool (spec §3.8, decision #17): 2 EVERGREEN horoscopes per sign per locale. No day names, no 'this week', nothing datable. Served when Gemini and the Room cache both miss; rotate by dayOfYear % 2. English is drafted; the other 8 locales are TODO. Regenerate all of it once with Gemini, hand-review, commit (SETUP.md step 13). Locales: en, hi, es, pt-PT, ja, zh-Hans, fr, de, it.

en: Your instinct to move first is an asset today; just leave a beat to check who is beside you before you charge ahead.
Energy is not the problem — aim is. Pick the one thing that matters and let the rest wait.
Steadiness is your quiet superpower; the slow, sure choice tends to outlast the flashy one.
Comfort is worth protecting, not hiding in. One small step outside the usual pays off.
Your curiosity opens doors; following one thread all the way through opens the good ones.
You can hold two ideas at once — say the clearer one out loud and watch things simplify.
Your read on how people feel is rarely wrong; trust it and act on it a little sooner.
Protecting your energy is not the same as withdrawing. Let the right person in.
Warmth is your currency; spend it on people who notice, not people who only take.
You do not need the spotlight to shine. Do the work you would be proud of unwatched.
Your eye for detail is a gift; aim it at what matters and let the small imperfections go.
Done and useful beats perfect and late. Ship the good-enough version.
You weigh every side well; at some point the scale has to tip. Choose, and move.
Harmony you build honestly lasts. Name the small disagreement before it grows.
Your focus is intense and rare; pointed at the right goal, very little can stop it.
Letting someone see a little more of you is a strength, not a risk.
Your appetite for the bigger picture keeps you moving; finish one map before you start the next.
Freedom feels best with one or two roots. Tend the ones you have.
You build things that hold; let yourself enjoy a finished step before reaching for the next.
Discipline is your default. Rest is the part you have to schedule on purpose.
Your way of seeing things sideways is the point, not a flaw; share it before you edit it down.
Ideas need people to land. Bring one person along with you.
Your imagination is a real tool; give it a shape and a deadline and it will surprise you.
Feeling everything is not a weakness. Choose which currents you follow.
